interaction.assumptions: 20 independent centrally symmetric cohort contrast vectors under the joint null; exploratory fixed-system interaction, not general biological heterogeneity

association.scope: Exploratory; same generator family and existing worlds. Truth-based rho/stress unavailable in real EEG. No universal no-association or deployment rule.

limitations: No positive RT control or new dataset
